284	   284	        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
285	   285	          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
286	   286	          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
287	   287	            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
288	   288	          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
289	   289	          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
290	   290	          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
291	   291	        fi
292	   292	        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
293	   293	        ;;
294	   294	      rule_files)
295	   295	        local r gone=""
296	   296	        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
297	   297	          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
298	   298	          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
299	   299	        done
300	   300	        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
301	   301	        ;;
302	   302	      audit_delta_instruction)
303	   303	        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
304	   304	        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
305	   305	        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
306	   306	          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
307	   307	        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
308	   308	        ;;
309	   309	      loa_mount)
310	   310	        local p left=""
311	   311	        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
312	   312	          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
313	   313	        done
314	   314	        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
315	   315	        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
316	   316	        ;;
317	   317	      effort)
318	   318	        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
319	   319	        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
320	   320	          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
321	   321	          total=$((total + 1))
322	   322	          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
323	   323	          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
324	   324	        done
325	   325	        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
326	   326	        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
327	   327	        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
328	   328	          local nkeys
329	   329	          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
330	   330	          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \

332	   332	          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
333	   333	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
334	   334	          local wrong
335	   335	          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
336	   336	          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
337	   337	          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
338	   338	          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
339	   339	            local h

341	   341	            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
342	   342	            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
343	   343	            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
344	   344	          fi
345	   345	        fi
346	   346	        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
347	   347	        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
348	   348	        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
349	   349	        ;;

353	   353	        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false

355	   355	        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
356	   356	        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
357	   357	        ;;

359	   359	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \

361	   361	        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
362	   362	        ;;
363	   363	      sprint_plan)

365	   365	        ;;

368	   368	        ;;

372	   372	  return 0
373	   373	}

376	   376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
377	   377	  local ws="$1"
378	   378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
379	   379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
380	   380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
381	   381	    return 0
382	   382	  fi
383	   383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
384	   384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	   385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
386	   386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
387	   387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
388	   388	  else
389	   389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
390	   390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
391	   391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
392	   392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
393	   393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
394	   394	    : > "$sums"
395	   395	    local -a batch=()
396	   396	    local f
397	   397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
398	   398	      batch+=("$f")
399	   399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
400	   400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
401	   401	        batch=()
402	   402	      fi
403	   403	    done < "$list"
404	   404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
405	   405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
406	   406	    fi
407	   407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
408	   408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
409	   409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
410	   410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
411	   411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
412	   412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
413	   413	  fi
414	   414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
415	   415	  local digest
416	   416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
417	   417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
418	   418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
419	   419	  return 0
420	   420	}

423	   423	check_fixture_path_rule() {
424	   424	  local dir="$1"
425	   425	  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || { _sm_err "check_fixture_path_rule: fixture not found: $dir"; return 2; }
426	   426	  local p bad=""
427	   427	  for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run; do
428	   428	    if [[ -e "$dir/$p" || -L "$dir/$p" ]]; then bad="$bad $p"; fi
429	   429	  done

431	   431	    echo "fixture path rule: $dir holds paths the Loa mount owns:$bad" >&2
432	   432	    return 2
433	   433	  fi
434	   434	  return 0
435	   435	}

438	   438	write_sandbox_grimoire() {
439	   439	  local ws="$1" task="$2" arm="$3" label="${4:-sprint-1}"
440	   440	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
441	   441	  [[ -f "$task" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task yaml not found: $task"; return 2; }
442	   442	  [[ "$label" =~ ^sprint-[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: invalid sprint label '$label'"; return 2; }
443	   443	  local tid ttype criterion task_md
444	   444	  tid="$(yq -r '.id // ""' "$task")"; ttype="$(yq -r '.type // ""' "$task")"
445	   445	  criterion="$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$task")"
446	   446	  [[ "$tid" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task id '$tid' invalid"; return 2; }
447	   447	  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
448	   448	  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
449	   449	  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }
450	   450	
451	   451	  local sprint_plan=true
452	   452	  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
453	   453	    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
454	   454	    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
455	   455	      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
456	   456	    fi
457	   457	  fi
458	   458	
459	   459	  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
460	   460	  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
461	   461	  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
462	   462	  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
463	   463	    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
464	   464	     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
465	   465	     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
466	   466	               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
467	   467	               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
468	   468	     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
469	   469	    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
470	   470	  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
471	   471	  {
472	   472	    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
473	   473	    cat "$task_md"
474	   474	  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
475	   475	  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"
476	   476	
477	   477	  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
478	   478	    {
479	   479	      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
480	   480	      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'
481	   481	      printf '### Tasks\n\n- [x] Task 1.1: the change in `pr/head.diff`\n\n'
482	   482	      printf '### Review scope\n\nThe gates review `pr/head.diff` (pass `--diff-file pr/head.diff` to the adversarial review). Cite findings as `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from the `pr/head/` files.\n\n'
483	   483	      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
484	   484	    } > "$g/sprint.md"
485	   485	    local prmd="$ws/pr/PR.md" rcfx
486	   486	    if [[ ! -f "$prmd" ]]; then
487	   487	      rcfx="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$task")"
488	   488	      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
489	   489	      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"
490	   490	    fi
491	   491	    [[ -f "$prmd" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no PR.md for review-catch task $tid"; return 2; }
492	   492	    { printf '# Implementation Report: %s\n\n' "$label"; cat "$prmd"; } > "$g/a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
493	   493	    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
494	   494	  fi
495	   495	  _sm_evidence grimoire "$wrote"
496	   496	  return 0
497	   497	}
498	   498

500	   500	init_sandbox_beads() {
501	   501	  local ws="$1" title="${2:-}"
502	   502	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
503	   503	  [[ -n "$title" ]] || title="eval task"

507	   507	      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: br init/create failed in $ws"; return 2; }
508	   508	    _sm_evidence beads "br"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
     4	#
     5	# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
     6	# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
     7	# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
     8	# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
     9	# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
    10	#
    11	# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
    12	# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
    13	#
    14	#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
    15	#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
    16	#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
    17	#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
    18	#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
    19	#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
    20	#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
    21	#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
    22	#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
    23	#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
    24	#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
    25	#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
    26	#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
    27	#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
    28	#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
    29	#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
    30	#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
    31	#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
    32	#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
    33	#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
    34	#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
    35	#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
    36	#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
    37	#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
    38	#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
    39	#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
    40	#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
    41	#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
    42	#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
    43	#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
    44	#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
    45	#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
    46	#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
    47	#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
    48	#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
    49	#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
    50	#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
    51	#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
    52	#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
    53	#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
    54	#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
    55	#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
    56	#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
    57	#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
    58	#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
    59	#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
    60	#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
    61	#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
    62	#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
    63	#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
    64	#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
    65	#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
    66	#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
    67	#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
    68	#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
    69	#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
    70	#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
    71	#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
    72	#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
    73	#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
    74	#
    75	# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
    76	# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
    77	# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
    78	#

    80	# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
    81	# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
    82	# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
    83	#

    96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
    97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
    98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
    99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
   100	# hashes the corpus the same way.
   101	_sm_sha256() {
   102	  python3 -I -c '
   103	import hashlib, sys
   104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
   105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   107	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   108	            h.update(b)
   109	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
   110	}

   112	# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
   113	_sm_evidence() {
   114	  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
   115	  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
   116	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
   117	  else
   118	    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
   119	    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
   120	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
   121	  fi
   122	}

   161	resolve_arm_toggles() {
   162	  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
   163	  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
   164	  local found=0 entry=""
   165	  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
   166	    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
   167	    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
   168	      || entry=""
   169	    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
   170	  fi
   171	  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
   172	    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
   173	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
   174	    return 2
   175	  fi
   176	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
   177	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
   178	    return 2
   179	  fi
   180	  local t
   181	  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
   182	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
   183	  printf '%s' "$t"
   184	}

   187	# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
   188	# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
   189	_sm_drop_md_section() {
   190	  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
   191	  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
   192	  awk -v h="$heading" '
   193	    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
   194	    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
   195	    skip { n++; next }
   196	    { print }
   197	    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
   198	  mv "$tmp" "$f"
   199	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
   200	}
   201	
   202	# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
   203	# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
   204	# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
   205	_sm_drop_paragraph() {
   206	  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
   207	import re, sys
   208	path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   209	text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
   210	paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
   211	for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
   212	    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
   213	        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
   214	            removed = paras[i]
   215	            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
   216	            del paras[i:i + 2]
   217	            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
   218	            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
   219	            sys.exit(0)
   220	sys.exit(1)
   221	PY
   222	}

   224	# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
   225	# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
   226	_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
   227	  local f="$1" tmp
   228	  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
   229	  awk '
   230	    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
   231	    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
   232	    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
   233	    { print }
   234	    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
   235	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
   236	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
   237	}
   238	
   239	# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
   240	_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
   241	  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
   242	}

   247	  local p

   251	  done

   255	apply_arm_toggles() {

   376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
   377	  local ws="$1"
   378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
   379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
   380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
   381	    return 0
   382	  fi
   383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
   384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
   386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
   387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
   388	  else
   389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
   390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
   391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
   392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
   393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
   394	    : > "$sums"
   395	    local -a batch=()
   396	    local f
   397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
   398	      batch+=("$f")
   399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
   400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
   401	        batch=()
   402	      fi
   403	    done < "$list"
   404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
   406	    fi
   407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
   408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
   410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
   411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
   412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
   413	  fi
   414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
   415	  local digest
   416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
   417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
   418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
   419	  return 0
   420	}

3	     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
4	     4	#
5	     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
6	     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
7	     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
8	     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch

10	    10	#
11	    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
12	    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
13	    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).

15	    15	# Derived fields:
16	    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
17	    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
18	    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
19	    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)

21	    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
22	    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)

24	    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),

28	    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer

30	    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});

341	     2	# =============================================================================
342	     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
343	     4	#
344	     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
345	     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
346	     7	#
347	     8	# Usage:
348	     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
349	    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
350	    11	#
351	    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
352	    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
353	    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
354	    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
355	    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
356	    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
357	    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
358	    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
359	    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
360	    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
361	    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
362	    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
363	    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
364	    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
365	    26	#
366	    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
367	    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
368	    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
369	    30	#
370	    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
371	    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
372	    33	# =============================================================================
373	    34	set -euo pipefail
374	    35	export LC_ALL=C
375	    36	
376	    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
377	    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
378	    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
379	    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
380	    41	RUNS=()
381	    42	
382	    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
383	    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
384	    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
385	    46	
386	    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
387	    48	  case "$1" in
388	    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
389	    50	    --runs)
390	    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
391	    52	      shift
392	    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
393	    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
394	    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
395	    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
396	    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
397	    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
398	    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
399	    60	  esac
400	    61	done
401	    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
402	    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
403	    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
404	    65	
405	    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
406	    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
407	    68	  local v
408	    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
409	    70	  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"

412	    73	}

421	    82	fi

423	    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
424	    85	
425	    86	# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
426	    87	if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
427	    88	  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
428	    89	  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
429	    90	fi
430	    91	EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
431	    92	if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
432	    93	  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
433	    94	  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
434	    95	fi
435	    96	for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
436	    97	  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
437	    98	done
438	    99	if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
439	   100	  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
440	   101	else
441	   102	  LEDGER=""
442	   103	fi
443	   104	
444	   105	python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
445	   106	import json, sys
446	   107	from datetime import datetime, timezone
447	   108	
448	   109	since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
449	   110	runs_files = sys.argv[6:]
450	   111	
451	   112	def ts(s):
452	   113	    s = s.strip()
453	   114	    if len(s) == 10:
454	   115	        s += "T00:00:00Z"
455	   116	    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
456	   117	    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
457	   118	
458	   119	since = ts(since_s)
459	   120	skipped = 0
460	   121	runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
461	   122	seen = set()
462	   123	for f in runs_files:
463	   124	    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
464	   125	        if not line.strip():
465	   126	            continue
466	   127	        try:
467	   128	            r = json.loads(line)
468	   129	            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
469	   130	        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
470	   131	            skipped += 1
471	   132	            continue
472	   133	        rid = r.get("run_id")
473	   134	        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
474	   135	        if key is not None and key in seen:
475	   136	            dedup += 1
476	   137	            continue
477	   138	        if key is not None:
478	   139	            seen.add(key)
479	   140	        runs_usd += c
480	   141	        runs_rows += 1
481	   142	
482	   143	ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
483	   144	if ledger:
484	   145	    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
485	   146	        if not line.strip():
486	   147	            continue
487	   148	        try:
488	   149	            r = json.loads(line)
489	   150	            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
490	   151	                continue
491	   152	            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
492	   153	            ledger_rows += 1
493	   154	        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
494	   155	            skipped += 1
495	   156	
496	   157	total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
497	   158	headroom = cap - total
498	   159	if skipped:
499	   160	    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
500	   161	def n(x):
501	   162	    x = round(x, 4)
502	   163	    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
503	   164	if as_json:
504	   165	    print(json.dumps({
505	   166	        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
506	   167	        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
507	   168	        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
508	   169	        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;

3	     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
4	     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
5	     5	#
6	     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
7	     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
8	     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
9	     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
10	    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
11	    11	#
12	    12	# Rules:
13	    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
14	    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
15	    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
16	    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
17	    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
18	    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
19	    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
20	    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
21	    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false

25	    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
26	    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
27	    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
28	    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
29	    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
30	    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium

468	     3	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
469	     4	#
470	     5	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
471	     6	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
472	     7	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
473	     8	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
474	     9	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
475	    10	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
476	    11	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
477	    12	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
478	    13	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
479	    14	#
480	    15	# Usage:
481	    16	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
482	    17	#
483	    18	# Options:
484	    19	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
485	    20	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
486	    21	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
487	    22	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
488	    23	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
489	    24	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
490	    25	#
491	    26	# Exit codes:
492	    27	#   0  printed
493	    28	#   2  usage error
494	    29	#
495	    30	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
496	    31	# =============================================================================

575	    13	#
576	    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
577	    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
578	    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
579	    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
580	    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
581	    19	#
582	    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
583	    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
584	    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
585	    23	#
586	    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
587	    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
588	    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
589	    27	# =============================================================================
590	    28	set -euo pipefail
591	    29	export LC_ALL=C
592	    30	
593	    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
594	    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
595	    33	
596	    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
597	    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
598	    36	VARGS=()
599	    37	
600	    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
601	    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
602	    40	
603	    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
604	    42	  case "$1" in
605	    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
606	    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
607	    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
608	    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
609	    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
610	    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
611	    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
612	    50	  esac
613	    51	done
614	    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
615	    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
616	    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
617	    55	
618	    56	vrc=0
619	    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
620	    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
621	    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
622	    60	
623	    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
624	    62	compute_manifest() {
625	    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
626	    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
627	    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
628	    66	  local d
629	    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
630	    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
631	    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
632	    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
633	    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
634	    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
635	    73	import hashlib, os, sys
636	    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
637	    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
638	    76	    if not rel:
639	    77	        continue
640	    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
641	    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
642	    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
643	    81	            h.update(b)
644	    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
645	    83	PY
646	    84	  rm -f "$list"
647	    85	}
648	    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
649	    87	
650	    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
651	    89	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
652	    90	compute_manifest "$TMP"
653	    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
654	    92	
655	    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
656	    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
657	    95	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
658	    96	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
659	    97	    exit 0
660	    98	  fi
661	    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
662	   100	  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
663	   101	import sys
664	   102	def load(p):
665	   103	    m = {}
666	   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
667	   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
668	   106	        if line:
669	   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
670	   108	            m[rel] = h
671	   109	    return m
672	   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
673	   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
674	   112	    if rel not in new:
675	   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
676	   114	    elif rel not in old:
677	   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
678	   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
679	   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
680	   118	PY
681	   119	  exit 1
682	   120	fi
683	   121	
684	   122	cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
685	   123	echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
686	   124	exit 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   125	}
   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac
   136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
   137	}
   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   140	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
   141	  EVID="no PLAN record"
   142	}
   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
   145	  for g in review audit; do
   146	    f="$(envelope "$g")"
   147	    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
   148	    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
   151	    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
   152	  done
   153	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
   154	  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
   155	}
   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   158	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
   159	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
   160	}
   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   162	  local f n=0 bad=""
   163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   164	    n=$((n + 1))
   165	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
   166	  done < <(argv_files)
   167	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   168	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
   169	  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
   170	}
   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   172	  local n=0
   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
   177	  fi
   178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
   179	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
   180	  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
   181	}
   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   195	  done < <(argv_files)
   196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
   198	}
   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
   210	}
   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)
   217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
   219	}
   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))
   225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))
   228	  done
   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
   232	}
   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:

     8	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
     9	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
    10	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
    11	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
    12	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
    13	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).

# sha256_portable - Portable SHA-256 hashing (sprint-bug-172 / bug-911)
# =============================================================================
#
# GNU coreutils ships `sha256sum`; macOS ships `shasum -a 256` (Perl-based
# from BSD's stock toolchain). Loa framework scripts that called raw
# sha256sum silently produced empty hashes on macOS, cascading into
# validation FAILs (e.g., butterfreezone-gen → butterfreezone-validate
# returning 10/12 instead of 12/12 provenance tagged).
#
# Argv shape matches sha256sum exactly: pass file paths positionally, or
# pipe content via stdin. Output format is byte-identical between GNU and
# BSD (`<hex-hash>  <filename-or-dash>` with two spaces), so downstream
# parsing via `awk '{print $1}'` or `cut -d' ' -f1` works unchanged.
#
# Arguments:
#   Same as sha256sum: zero or more file paths. With no args, reads stdin.
#
# Exit codes:
#   0    - hashing succeeded
#   127  - neither sha256sum nor shasum found in PATH (fail loud, no silent
#          empty-hash emission — that's exactly the bug #911 failure class)
#   other - backend tool's own exit code (e.g., file-not-found from
#           sha256sum/shasum)
#
# Usage:
#   echo "content" | sha256_portable | awk '{print $1}'
#   sha256_portable file.txt | cut -d' ' -f1
#   sha256_portable a.txt b.txt c.txt  # multi-file form
#
sha256_portable() {
  case "$_COMPAT_SHA256_CMD" in
    gnu)
      sha256sum "$@"
      ;;
    bsd)
      shasum -a 256 "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      echo "ERROR: sha256_portable: neither sha256sum (GNU) nor shasum (BSD) found in PATH" >&2
      echo "       Install GNU coreutils (Linux: apt/yum/pacman 'coreutils'; macOS: 'brew install coreutils')" >&2
      echo "       or Perl (macOS ships shasum from /usr/bin/shasum by default)." >&2
      return 127
      ;;
  esac
}

# =============================================================================
# ucfirst - Portable upper-case of the first character (issue #1069)
# =============================================================================
#
# GNU sed's `s/^./\U&/` uppercase escape is NOT portable: BSD/macOS sed takes
# `\U` literally and emits a stray `U` prefix (e.g. "Ucompositions"). This
# stdin filter upper-cases the first character of each line via awk's toupper(),
# which is POSIX (gawk / mawk / BSD awk). Same portability family as
# sha256_portable (#911) and _date_to_epoch (#1034).
#
# Usage (stdin filter):  printf '%s' "$name" | ucfirst
ucfirst() {
  awk '{ print toupper(substr($0, 1, 1)) substr($0, 2) }'
}

   183	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   184	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   185	verify_corpus() {
   186	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   187	import hashlib, os, sys
   188	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   189	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   190	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   191	bad = []
   192	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   193	    if not line.strip():
   194	        continue
   195	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   196	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   197	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   198	        continue
   199	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   200	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   201	        bad.append(rel)
   202	# audit r1 DISS-C-002: a file present on disk but absent from SHA256SUMS is drift too
   203	# (the seed's --check already says so; the runner must agree), else an added file
   204	# would reach the sandbox under an unchanged corpus digest.
   205	listed = {l.split("  ", 1)[1] for l in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()}
   206	walk_root = os.path.join(corpus, only) if only else corpus
   207	for root, _d, files in os.walk(walk_root):
   208	    for f in files:
   209	        rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), corpus)
   210	        if rel == "SHA256SUMS" or rel in listed:
   211	            continue
   212	        if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/")):
   213	            continue
   214	        bad.append(rel + " (not listed)")
   215	if only:
   216	    for extra in (f"manifests/{only}.json", "corpus.tsv"):
   217	        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(corpus, extra)) and extra not in listed:
   218	            bad.append(extra + " (not listed)")
   219	    ldir = os.path.join(corpus, "labels")
   220	    if os.path.isdir(ldir):
   221	        for f in os.listdir(ldir):
   222	            rel = f"labels/{f}"
   223	            if f.startswith(only + ".") and rel not in listed:
   224	                bad.append(rel + " (not listed)")
   225	if bad:
   226	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   227	    sys.exit(1)
   228	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   229	PY
   230	}

   380	    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
   381	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
   382	     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
   383	     cuts: [.[] | select(.cut != null) | .cut + {batch}],
   384	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
   385	        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
   386	                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
   387	                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
   388	     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   389	     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   390	     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \

   392	    && mv "$agg.tmp" "$agg"

   394	}
   395	set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }
   396	
   397	# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
   398	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
   399	  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
   400	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
   401	  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
   402	  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
   403	  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0

   405	  # output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry by mentioning a network
   406	  # error; the patterns are the CLI's transport messages, not free text.
   407	  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]' \
   408	    "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0

   410	}
   411	
   412	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
   413	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
   414	  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
   415	  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
   416	  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
   417	  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
   418	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
   419	  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   420	  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
   421	    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
   422	  fi
   423	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
   424	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
   425	    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
   426	    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
   427	      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
   428	    ex_rc=0
   429	    # audit r1 DISS-C-001: the arm's toggles come from the suite declaration only; a
   430	    # LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES inherited from the parent environment never reaches a trial
   431	    env -u LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES \
   432	      EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
   433	      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
   434	      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   435	        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
   436	        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
   437	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
   438	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
   439	      local gout gexit=0
   440	      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   441	        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
